# Synthetic DeepSeek fixtures

Shaped by the DeepSeek API documentation (EVID-012: `guides/responses_api.md`,
`guides/files_api.md`). Every id and value is synthetic. No key, no real
document and no recorded live payload is stored here. The UNK-006 live probe
replaces these with redacted recordings only after it has run on Staging with
synthetic documents.
